00.name: The Fool
00.main_text:
Whatever his experience, the Fool goes on trusting. You deceive him, and he trusts you. You fool him again, and still he believes in you.

So you decide he must be stupid, that he learns nothing from experience. His trust is so great and so pure that no one can corrupt it.

Be a fool in the Taoist sense, in the spirit of Zen. Give up trying to build a wall of knowledge around you. Whatever experience comes your way, accept it and then let it go.

Keep clearing your mind. Let the past die again and again so that you can stay here, now, **like a newborn child.**
00.commentary:
If you trust your intuition now, your own sense of what feels right, you cannot go wrong, even if what you do seems foolish to others.

---

01.name: Existence
01.main_text:
Your presence here is no accident. **Existence needs you.** Without you, something would be missing, and no one else can take your place. That is where your dignity lies.

In your absence, the sun, the moon, the stars, the trees, the birds and the Earth would feel that empty place that only you can fill. There is immense joy, a kind of bliss, in knowing that you belong to existence.

Existence takes an interest in you. Then the clear and simple being that you are becomes aware of an infinite love pouring in from every side.
01.commentary:
It is time to ask yourself whether you feel at home wherever you are.

If you do, savour that feeling. Give it time to deepen and take root in you.

If, on the other hand, you feel that everyone is against you, it is time for a pause. Go outside tonight and look at the stars.

---

02.name: Inner Voice
02.main_text:
Once you have discovered your truth deep within, there is nothing left for you to seek in existence. **Truth speaks through you.**

When you open your eyes, it is truth that opens its eyes. When you close them, it is truth that lowers its eyelids. What a beautiful meditation.

When you understand this simple thing, there is nothing more to do, because everything you do is an expression of truth. You walk, and truth moves. You sleep, and truth rests. You speak, and truth finds its voice. You are silent, and truth says nothing.
02.commentary:
Sometimes there seem to be far too many voices in our lives, pulling us in every direction. In our confusion, we begin to look within ourselves for quiet and harmony.

Then we can hear our own truth.

---

03.name: Creativity
03.main_text:
Creativity is the particular quality you bring to whatever you are doing. It is an attitude, an inner disposition, a way of seeing things.

It would be impossible for everyone to be an artist, and there is no need for everyone to be one. If everybody took up painting, the world would be a strange place and difficult to live in. It is the same with dancing. We cannot all be dancers, nor do we have to be.

Yet anyone can be creative. Whatever you give your time to, if you do it with joy and love, for more than what you stand to gain, **then you are creative.**

Everything within you, everything that helps you grow inwardly, is spiritual, creative and divine. Love what you do. Whatever you are doing, let it be a meditation!
03.commentary:
It makes little difference what you do. You might paint or sing, tend a garden or make a meal.

What matters is being open to the activity and to what you wish to express through it.

---

04.name: The Rebel
04.main_text:
A person who has come fully into their own can neither be enslaved nor imprisoned. That is precisely the problem. Someone who knows and lives their inner truth is hard to manipulate and is therefore a troublemaker.

The crowd would rather such a person left it in peace, even when it is suffering. Suffering is familiar. To the crowd, anyone who appears free of it seems strange.

The fulfilled human being is the most striking outsider in this world. They seem to belong to nothing and no one. **No organisation, society or nation can sway them.**
04.commentary:
Rich or poor, the Rebel is a true emperor. He has broken the chains imposed by society and the opinions of others. He has discovered his own nature and is determined to live in harmony with it.

The Rebel invites us to find the courage to take responsibility for who we really are and to live our truth.

---

05.name: No-Thingness
05.main_text:
The Buddha used a powerful word, “shunyata”, which translates as “the void” or “emptiness”. Neither word quite conveys its meaning. Shunyata says much more.

Emptiness embodies all the fleeting things in this world that are unreal, full of sorrow and mere appearances. Yet this emptiness holds every possibility within it. Its potential is absolute.

Shunyata has yet to take form, and for that very reason it already contains everything.

In the beginning, nature is there. At the end, it is still there. Why torment yourself over what comes in between? Why so much fear, worry, ambition and despair?

**From emptiness to emptiness. That is the journey.**
05.commentary:
The experience of emptiness can be bewildering, a frightening passage. There is nothing left to hold on to, no direction to follow. Every trace of possibility seems to have been erased.

Yet emptiness is the state of pure potential that precedes the creation of the universe. All that remains is to relax and plunge into that emptiness… Soon something sacred will be born.

---

06.name: The Lovers
06.main_text:
Sexuality is the most basic level of love. It is physical love. Compassion is love at its highest. Sexuality comes before love, compassion lies beyond it, and love itself lies in between.

Very few people know what love is. Most equate love with sexuality. That is a mistake. Sexuality is animal. It can certainly grow into love, but in itself sexuality is still a possibility.

If you are awake, aware and meditative, you can transform sexuality into love. And when your meditation becomes complete, love can turn into compassion.

**Sexuality is the seed, love is the flower, and compassion is its fragrance.**
06.commentary:
Whatever kind of love you are experiencing now, take time to consider it without condemning it, dressing it up or expecting anything of it.

Only when you accept it as it is can you take the next step.

---

07.name: Awareness
07.main_text:
The mind is incapable of being intelligent. Only in its absence can something original and radical arise. Only the silence of the mind is rebellion. It actively rebels.

The mind draws you into a kind of lethargy. Weighed down by memories and preoccupied with plans for the future, you live like a flame turned low. You are barely living. Your inner flame is faint.

But as soon as you start to let go of your thoughts and clear away the dust your mind has gathered from the past, the flame grows taller, purer, clearer, more alive and younger.

Your whole life becomes a flame rising without smoke. **That is the meaning of awareness.**
07.commentary:
The awareness growing in you now is coming of its own accord.

Do nothing. Give up the struggle to make something happen. That sense of groping in the dark will soon begin to lift, perhaps disappearing altogether.

---

08.name: Courage
08.main_text:
The seed cannot know what will happen. It has no idea what a flower is. It does not even know that it has the power to become a magnificent flower.

The road is long. At first it seems wiser to stay put, for the way ahead leads into the unknown and there are no guarantees. Nothing is certain. The dangers are countless, the obstacles many. The seed lies hidden in its casing, safe from it all.

And yet the seed tries to emerge. It has the courage to break through the armour that has protected it until now. It begins to move. Its ordeal starts at once. It must find its way out of the soil and around the stones.

Once so hard inside its shell, it is now a tender, vulnerable shoot, open to every danger. The seed was safe where it lay. It could have survived there for centuries.

The shoot, by contrast, is threatened at every turn. Still it reaches into the unknown, towards the sun, towards the source of light, without knowing where it is going or why. Its cross is heavy to bear, but no matter. **A dream has taken hold of the seed, and it goes on.**

The human path is just the same, and just as difficult. It takes great courage to walk it.
08.commentary:
There is little use in fighting life's challenges, avoiding them or denying them.

Find your courage and become the flower you are meant to be.

---

09.name: Aloneness
09.main_text:
When you are by yourself, you may hardly know what it is to be alone. You simply feel lonely. There is a world of difference between loneliness and aloneness.

When you are lonely, you think about someone else and miss their presence. Loneliness is a negative state. You think you would feel better if someone were there with you, a friend, your partner, your mother, your beloved. But that person is elsewhere, and their absence hurts.

Loneliness is the absence of another, while aloneness is the presence of oneself. Aloneness is deeply positive because you are here in the present. Your presence is so complete, it fills you so deeply, that you could fill the whole universe on your own.

**Then you no longer need another person to be there.**
09.commentary:
When there is no one in our lives who plays a significant part for us, we can feel lonely, or we can enjoy the freedom of being alone.

When others are unable to understand our deepest truths, we can feel isolated and bitter, or we can be glad that our vision is strong enough to stand on its own, free of the need for recognition.

If you find yourself in this situation now, notice how you approach being alone and take responsibility for your choice.

---

10.name: Change
10.main_text:
Life goes on repeating itself like a turning wheel, for as long as you remain unaware. This is why Buddhists speak of the wheel of life and death, the wheel of time.

Birth leads to death and death to birth. Love gives way to hate and hate leads back to love. Success follows failure, and after failure comes success.

Look at this process! Observe it closely for a few days and you will see a pattern emerge, the pattern of the wheel.

One day you are happy. Another day you feel so depressed that you think of taking your own life, although you were once full of vitality and optimism, ready to thank God in your joy. Then everything goes wrong and life seems to have lost all meaning.

Life keeps unfolding, but you do not notice the pattern repeating. **The moment you recognise the pattern, you can step out of it.**
10.commentary:
Cling to the rim of the wheel and you will grow dizzy!

Move towards the centre of the cyclone and relax, knowing that **this too will pass.**

---

11.name: Breakthrough
11.main_text:
A master's one task is to turn a breakdown into a breakthrough. A psychotherapist simply puts you back on your feet. That is where the work ends. Transforming you is beyond the therapist's remit.

For that you need a metapsychology, the psychology of the buddhas. **The greatest adventure in life is to go through a breakdown consciously.** It is also the greatest risk, for there is no guarantee that your breakdown will become a breakthrough.

Your inner chaos is ancient. You have been lost for many lifetimes. Your confusion is vast, almost a world of its own. There is real danger, then, in plunging into that chaos accompanied only by your own frailty.

And yet no one has ever become whole, an individual at peace with themselves, without facing that danger. Meditation, Zen, is the method that helps you pass through the chaos, the “dark night of the soul”, with balance, discipline and alertness.
11.commentary:
Take the risk of breaking old patterns and putting down the burdens you no longer need.

You may be astonished at the vitality and spiritual energy this breakthrough brings.

---

12.name: New Vision
12.main_text:
When your innermost being opens, it first experiences two directions, height and depth.

Little by little this vision steadies, and you begin to look around you. Then you radiate out in the other eight directions.

Once you reach the point where height and depth meet, you perceive the true circumference of the universe. **Your awareness unfolds in all ten directions, yet the road remains the same.**
12.commentary:
You now have a chance to see life in all its dimensions, from the depths to the heights. All these levels exist together.

When experience teaches us that night and hardship are as necessary as daylight and ease, we begin to see the world with new eyes.

Letting every colour of life enter us makes us more whole.

---

13.name: Transformation
13.main_text:
The world of Zen is for courageous souls who can put aside faith, scepticism, convictions, reason and intellect, and simply embody their own pure, boundless existence. Belief will not take you there.

Zen brings immense transformation. Where other traditions concern themselves with philosophy, Zen devotes itself to metamorphosis and transformation.

Zen is true alchemy. **It turns the base metal in you into pure gold.** To understand its language, though, you must listen with the love in your heart and let go of reasoning it out.

You can also simply listen, setting aside the question of whether it is true or false. A moment will come when you suddenly realise how much you have missed all your life.

All at once, the “eighty-four thousand gates”, as the Buddha called them, will open.
13.commentary:
Allow pain, worries and difficulties their place. Accept the facts.

Transformation, like death, comes in its own time. Like death, it carries us from one dimension into another.

---

14.name: Integration
14.main_text:
The conflict is inside you, and only there can it be resolved. Political opposition exists within you, playing out between the two hemispheres of your brain.

A narrow passage connects these two parts of consciousness. In the event of an accident, a physiological deficiency or some other trauma, an individual's personality disintegrates and becomes schizophrenic.

When the fragile passage between these two worlds breaks down, the personality splits and the individual behaves like two different people. You might be gentle and charming in the morning and furious by evening. You no longer remember the person you were that morning. You have become someone else, governed by another brain.

When the ends of the two hemispheres are joined, the passage grows stronger and a unity takes shape. This is integration, or crystallisation.

**What Gurdjieff called the crystallisation of being is the fusion of these two parts of the brain.**
14.commentary:
The opposites in your life can now come together into a single whole.

A tremendous energy will be released. Make the most of this opportunity now.

---

15.name: Conditioning
15.main_text:
Until you let go of your personality, your “I”, you will not find your true individuality. **That individuality is the essence of your existence.**

Society imposes a personality on you and rejects the individual who refuses to follow the flock. The individual is like a lion, walking alone.

Sheep stay with the flock because it is comfortable and safe. Besides, should an enemy appear, a sheep stands a good chance of escaping notice among all the others. A lion takes the risk of standing out alone.
15.commentary:
This card tells an old Zen story about a lion brought up by sheep. He believed he was a sheep too, until one day an old lion made him look at his reflection in a pond.

Many of us are like that lion. The image we see of ourselves comes from other people's opinions of us rather than our own experience.

**It is your turn to look into the mirror of the pond** and free yourself from what others have led you to believe.

---

16.name: Thunderbolt
16.main_text:
What meditation brings about slowly can happen in an instant at the unexpected shout of a master.

A disciple asks a question, and the master leaps up, shouts, strikes him or seizes him roughly. Such methods were unknown before Zen. They owe their origin to the creative genius of Ma Tzu, a master who guided many people towards awakening.

It could sometimes be funny. A man came to ask Ma Tzu how to meditate, and Ma Tzu threw him out of a second-storey window. Then he jumped out too, landed on the visitor's chest and shouted, “Got it?”

The poor man answered yes for fear of what the master might do to him next. He had had enough. His bones were broken, and Ma Tzu was crushing his chest, yelling, “Got it?”

He had no choice. And so he did grasp the lesson he had been given. **The teaching had been so unexpected, so abrupt!** He could never have imagined such a thing.
16.commentary:
You may feel shaken just now, as if the earth were trembling beneath your feet. Your sense of security is threatened and you feel inclined to grab hold of anything you can.

Yet this inner earthquake is necessary and deeply significant. If you accept it, you will emerge from the wreckage stronger and ready for new experiences.

---

17.name: Silence
17.main_text:
The energy of the whole has taken possession of you. You are possessed. You are no longer there. Only the One exists.

The moment silence settles within you, you understand its meaning. It is the same silence known to the Buddha, Chuang Tzu, Bodhidharma and Nansen. **The taste of silence is universal.**

Time passes and the world changes constantly, yet the experience of silence and the joy it gives remain the same. It is the one thing you can count on, the one thing that never dies and that you can call your true being.
17.commentary:
This time is precious. It will be easy for you to gather yourself, to sound the depths of your inner silence and find the point where it meets the silence of the universe.

There is nothing you need to do, nowhere you need to go. Your inner silence spreads into everything you do. **The time has come to turn inward again.**

---

18.name: Past Lives
18.main_text:
A child can come into awareness only if, in a previous life, they devoted themselves to meditation and built up the meditative energy needed to face the darkness that comes with death.

The person who dies loses all awareness and suddenly finds themselves in a new womb, having entirely forgotten their previous body. The darkness, the loss of consciousness, creates a break.

The East has worked hard to open a way through these barriers. Ten thousand years of effort have borne fruit. Anyone can gain access to a past life, or to several.

To do this you must deepen your meditation. Without it, you will never find the door that opens onto another life. And when you do find that door, you must be deep in meditation, or what you encounter may overwhelm your mind. One life is already hard enough to manage.
18.commentary:
A glimpse of the eternity of our existence is a gift. An understanding of how karma works in our lives is hardly something we can summon at will.

It is a call to awaken. The events of your life are trying to show you a pattern as old as the journey of your own soul.

---

19.name: Innocence
19.main_text:
Zen says that if you let go of what you know, including your name, your identity and everything given to you from outside, your being will take on an entirely new quality, **the quality of innocence.**

It will be the crucifixion of your persona, your personality, and a resurrection of your innocence. You will be like a child again. You will be born anew.
19.commentary:
The innocence that comes from a deep experience of life is childlike without being childish.

A child's innocence is beautiful and unknowing. It gives way to mistrust and doubt as the child grows and discovers that the world can be threatening and dangerous.

Yet the innocence of a life fully lived has an air of wisdom about it. It accepts that life, forever changing, is a mystery.

---

20.name: Beyond Illusion
20.main_text:
Why did people like the Buddha insist so strongly that all existence, apart from your inner witness, your awareness, is fleeting and made of the same stuff as dreams?

The Buddha is hardly claiming that trees do not exist. Take care with the word “illusion”. It is only an awkward translation of “maya”.

An illusion has no existence, while reality does exist. Maya lies exactly between the two. It is a passing reality, something that almost exists.

Our everyday life can be regarded as real. Yet in the ultimate sense, at the highest level of consciousness, **what was real becomes illusory and ceases to exist.**
20.commentary:
This card invites us to turn our gaze inward and give up looking outside ourselves for reality.

When we focus on what is outside, it is easy to get lost in judgements. “This is good.” “That is bad.” “I want this.” “I don't want that.” These opinions hold us captive in a world of illusion and old habits. We turn into robots, sleepwalkers.

Free yourself from your opinionated mind and turn inward. Relax into the deep truth of your being, **where you have always known the difference between a dream and reality.**

---

21.name: Completion
21.main_text:
It is typical of Zen to leave something unsaid. Try to understand this, for it is an important method.

Leaving something unsaid gives your listener room to complete the situation for themselves. An answer is never absolute. The master only points in a direction. When you reach the limit, you will know what remains.

If you try to grasp Zen with the intellect, you will fail. Zen is less about receiving an answer to a question than about understanding something far greater.

Zen shows us reality. Your buddha-nature is near at hand. **Your very awareness is that nature.** And your awareness can witness everything that makes up the world. The world will go out, but the mirror will remain, reflecting emptiness.
21.commentary:
Something that has occupied your time and energy until now is coming to an end.

Bringing it to completion opens the door to a new experience. Take this pause to celebrate both sides of this moment, the ending of what is complete and the arrival of something new.

---

22.name: The Master
22.main_text:
Masters cannot teach the truth, because truth cannot be passed on. What the master teaches you goes further, beyond texts and words.

It is an energy the master stirs in you, a kind of synchronicity. You must approach a master with great love, complete trust and an open heart.

You do not know who you are. The master knows who he is **and** who you are. Like the caterpillar that has no idea it can become a butterfly, you are that caterpillar, a bodhisattva.

All caterpillars become bodhisattvas, and all bodhisattvas were once caterpillars. Bodhisattvas can turn into butterflies, and the butterfly in turn can become a buddha. It carries that potential within, for **it is a buddha in essence.**
22.commentary:
In Zen the master has mastery over himself and has no need to dominate anyone else. Each gesture and every word reflect the awakened being he is.

He has no personal goals or wish for things to be different from what they are. His disciples gather around him. They come to absorb his presence and draw inspiration from his example, rather than to follow him.

In the eyes of the master, you see your own truth. In his silence, it is easier to drop into the silence of your own being.

If you can find such a master, you are blessed. If you cannot, keep searching. Learn everything there is to be learned from teachers and self-proclaimed masters, then continue on your way.

“Charaiveti,” said the Buddha. **Keep going, go ever further.**

---

23.name: The Creator
23.main_text:
There are two kinds of creators in the world. The first works with things, giving them tangible form, as a painter or a poet does.

The second, the mystic, creates himself. The mystery within his own being is his material. He is the true creator, the true poet, because he makes a masterpiece of himself.

A beautiful mystery waits to be revealed in you, too, but your small self keeps it from coming to the surface. Step aside a little and the wonder within you can show itself.

**Each of us is a masterpiece,** for the divine source gives birth only to perfect beings. We all carry a magnificent essence that has been hidden for many lifetimes. Unaware of what it truly is, we try to become “somebody” on the surface.

Let go of the idea of becoming that somebody. You are already your own masterpiece, and nothing can improve on it. You need only accept this and discover who you already are.

God himself created you. That is why there is no improving on you.
23.commentary:
The King of Fire tells you that whatever you undertake now with the understanding that comes from maturity enriches your life and the lives of others.

Use your talents and everything your own experience has taught you. **The time has come to express who you are.**

----------

24.name: Sharing
24.main_text:
When you reach the fourth energy centre, the heart, your whole life fills with love.

The third energy centre, just before it, holds an abundance of love. When you reach that centre through meditation, you overflow with love and compassion and you want to share. That impulse finds expression in the fourth centre, the heart.

This is why even the most ordinary person thinks love comes from the heart. They know it by hearsay and cannot tell whether it is true, since they have never had access to the energy of their own heart.

The person who meditates enters that realm. On reaching the centre of their being, the third energy centre, they suddenly feel an explosion of love, compassion, joy and blessing so powerful that the heart opens.
24.commentary:
You have an opportunity to share your love, your joy and your laughter. As you share, you will feel your own inner fullness grow.

There is no need to go anywhere or make a special effort. You can delight in sensuality without having to cling to anyone or possess another person.

This feeling of creativity may give birth to a child or to a new project. **Either can bring you fulfilment.**

----------

25.name: Intensity
25.main_text:
Zen says to regard all fine words and great teachings as mortal enemies. Avoid them, for you must find your own source.

You have no need to be a believer or an imitator. You must discover your innermost being for yourself, without a guide or sacred writings.

The night is dark, but the fire of your search casts so intense a light that it is bound to reach the rising sun. **All those who have sought the light with the ardour of a blazing fire have found it.** The rest are content to believe.

Belief itself keeps a believer from being religious, for it stands in the way of the great adventure of the religious search.
25.commentary:
When you act with the intensity of the Knight of Fire, expect to stir things up around you. Some will be invigorated by your presence, while others may feel threatened or annoyed.

What others think is of little importance. **Nothing can hold you back now.**

----------

26.name: Playfulness
26.main_text:
As soon as you begin to take life a little less seriously, all the burdens that weigh on your heart disappear.

Your fear of death, of life and of love falls away. The life you then lead becomes light, almost weightless. You might even take off into the sky.

Zen offers a different possibility to the serious person. This is its greatest gift. Serious people built the world and established every religion. They created philosophies, cultures and codes of morality. Everything you see around you is their creation.

Zen stepped away from the world of serious people. **It created a world of its own, full of laughter and play, where the greatest masters behave like children.**
26.commentary:
When the Page of Fire comes into your life, it is a sign that you are ready for something fresh and new.

Something wonderful is on the horizon, and you have the playful innocence and clarity within you to welcome it with open arms.

----------

27.name: The Source
27.main_text:
Zen asks you to leave your head and return to the source you came from. Zen acknowledges that the energy of the brain has its uses. But if all your vital energy gathers in your brain, you will never become aware of the eternal being that you are.

You will never experience being one with the whole. When energy stays at the centre of your being, vibrant and concentrated, it flows neither to the head nor to the heart. It is the very source from which both draw their energy. When you rest there, you are in a state of zazen.

Zazen means simply staying at the source, without going anywhere. Then a tremendous force arises. Energy turns into light and love, into a more expansive life, into compassion and creativity. **This can take many forms.**

First, though, you must learn to find your way back to this source. It reveals the true potential within you. Relax and trust the energy at the source, and you will feel what is truly possible for you.
27.commentary:
Whether you are starting something, looking for inspiration, or have just finished something and want to rest, return to the Source.

It is always there inside you. You need not even leave home to find it.

----------

28.name: Possibilities
28.main_text:
The mind readily accepts the idea that there are limits everywhere. Yet the very nature of existence is infinite.

What lies beyond the farthest reaches of space? More space. That is why I tell you that whoever takes flight finds a universe of infinite breadth.

Do not settle for too little. Someone who asks for very little stays in a small world. Their joys, their moments of ecstasy, their silences, their very being are all diminished. Nothing requires this of you! You yourself impose these narrow bounds on your freedom, your possibilities, your limitless potential.
28.commentary:
Many possibilities are opening up for you now. Because you feel more affection for yourself and have grown more self-reliant, you find it easy to work with other people.

Because you feel relaxed and at ease in yourself, you recognise opportunities as they arise, before others see them. Because you are in harmony with your own nature, you understand that existence brings you exactly what you need.

Enjoy your flight! **Celebrate all the wonders of the landscape opening up before you.**

----------

29.name: Experiencing
29.main_text:
Look around you. Look into the eyes of a child, of your beloved, of your mother, of a friend. Or simply touch a tree.

Have you ever put your arms around a tree? Try it. One day you will realise that you have done more than caress the tree. It has answered in its own way, showing its affection for you in return.

Then, for the first time, you will know that a tree is far more than a form of plant life, more than a species botanists discuss. **Here is a god in hiding, yet so close to you, green and flowering in your garden.** It beckons to you and never tires of calling your name.
29.commentary:
There are experiences you can write up in a notebook, capture on film, or paste into an album.

To experience something as it happens awakens wonder in us, the elation of communion. Like a gentle caress, it lets us feel how our very existence is bound up with everything around us.

----------

30.name: Participation
30.main_text:
Have you ever watched the night fade away? Few people really notice what happens every day. Have you ever watched dusk come on? Heard the music of the middle of the night? Watched the beauty of the sun rising?

You go about as though you were blind. The world is so beautiful, yet you are content to live in the little puddle of your own misery. It is so familiar that when someone tries to lift you out, you resist with all your might. You have no wish to leave your misery, your suffering.

Yet joy is everywhere. All it takes is to notice and become a participant instead of remaining a spectator. Philosophy is speculation. Zen is participation.

Take part in the departing night, in the gathering dusk, in the stars and clouds. **Let participation become your way of life.** Your whole existence will become a joy, an ecstasy. You will be unable to dream of a better world.
30.commentary:
You have the chance to join other people in creating something greater and more beautiful than you could make alone.

Your contribution will nourish you and add a precious touch to the picture as a whole.

----------

31.name: Totality
31.main_text:
At any moment you can give something your undivided attention. Whatever you are doing, let it absorb you so completely that your mind thinks of nothing else.

The mind becomes a simple presence. More and more, a sense of wholeness will surround you. The more often you experience that integrity, the more you will grow into a whole person.

Try to recognise the moments when you are less than wholly present, and gradually change this inner attitude. When you rack your brains, you are never entirely there. You think, brood, calculate, hatch schemes.

These are only old habits, and you can shed them little by little. They are certainly hard to uproot, but if you persevere, one day they will be a distant memory.
31.commentary:
Trapeze artists cannot afford to lose their concentration for even a fraction of a second. This card embodies that quality of absolute alertness in the present moment.

Learning to respond with your whole being to whatever comes your way is one of the greatest gifts you can give yourself.

When we take life one step at a time and give all our energy and attention to what we are doing, our actions take on a new energy, **vibrant and wonderfully creative.**

----------

32.name: Success
32.main_text:
Watch the waves on the ocean. The higher a wave rises, the deeper it falls. You too are like a wave, passing from crest to trough.

Savour both moments without favouring either. Do not say, “I wish I could always be at my peak.” It is impossible. It goes against the nature of things.

Do not set your heart on it. It has never happened and never will. What can you do, then? Enjoy the summit for as long as it lasts, and welcome the valley when its turn comes.

What is wrong with being in the valley? Why resist being “down”? It is a kind of pause, a chance to relax. The summit is exciting, but no one can sustain that exhilaration for long.
32.commentary:
Now, or very soon, you may have the joy of riding the magnificent tiger of success. Welcome the moment with open arms and share your happiness with others.

Remember that even a shower of streamers has a beginning and an end. The essential wisdom to carry with you through life's ups and downs is that **“this too will pass.”**

Celebrate the occasion fully, and keep riding the tiger.

----------

33.name: Stress
33.main_text:
All purely personal goals are neurotic. An authentic person knows and feels that they are part of the whole. They have no need to chase a private destiny.

Events unfold. The universe, or God if you prefer, takes shape and reveals itself. Things happen of their own accord. You need not strain and struggle.

Once you understand the essence of who you are, you can relax and simply be. The authentic person is no “doer”. A person who lives by accident intervenes in the course of things and tries to steer it.

Such a person is anxious, tense, stressed, full of dread. Believing the world to be a place of certainty, they seem to live on an inner volcano that could erupt at any moment.

Yet deep inside, a great conflict stirs, for they sense the truth, **that nothing is certain.**
33.commentary:
The tension and stress pictured on this card get to all of us from time to time. Perfectionists are particularly susceptible.

They imagine that without them the Earth would stop turning, or at least stop turning the way they want it to. If that sounds familiar, ask yourself a few questions.

What makes you think you are so special? Do you really believe the sun will forget to rise if you forget to set your alarm?

Go for a walk, buy yourself flowers, cook yourself something good. Do anything you like, as long as it is of no particular importance. Then you will be beyond the reach of that mischievous little monkey!

----------

34.name: Traveling
34.main_text:
Life is a continuum without beginning or end. It goes on and on, with no ultimate goal.

The journey, the pilgrimage itself, is what gives life its character. Reaching a goal has little to do with it. To live is to dance for the sheer pleasure of dancing, without a thought for where it might lead.

Everyone tries to organise life around a set of goals. But once you have reached the last one, what then? Think about what that would mean...

If you really do fulfil your ambition, you will find yourself at a loss. One day you have come to the end of the road, and along the way you have lost everything. It is inevitable.

After pouring everything you had into a project of your own, you stand there naked and foolish. What have you really achieved?

What was all the effort, all the rushing, all the worry for? **What did it bring you?**
34.commentary:
This card invites us to welcome what is new, as we might on arriving in a foreign country with different customs and unfamiliar landscapes.

This openness and willingness to accept what comes bring new friends and new experiences into our lives.

----------

35.name: Exhaustion
35.main_text:
Someone who lives by the dictates of a moral conscience grows rigid. Someone who lives from inner awareness stays flexible.

Why? Because a fixed idea of how your life should develop automatically makes you harden. You must constantly maintain the armour encasing your character, for it gives you protection and security.

You cease to act naturally and rely on your armour to respond to every situation. When someone asks you a question, you have a ready-made answer.

Monotony, dullness and mechanical behaviour are the hallmarks of someone who has hardened. They might make a good computer, but hardly a human being. You know in advance how they will behave. Their response is as predictable as a machine's.

An authentic person acts spontaneously. They answer a question in the light of the reality of that moment. The answer is more than a reflex, because to give it **they open their heart, make themselves vulnerable and truly listen...**
35.commentary:
Life is a mystery to be lived, rather than a business to be managed.

It is time to put away your time card, leave the factory and venture into the unknown. **You will work so much better when you are relaxed!**

----------

36.name: Suppression
36.main_text:
The Sanskrit term alaya vigyan refers to a house. Into its cellar you throw everything you would have liked to do, everything you deny yourself because of social conditioning, culture and civilisation.

The things you repress keep accumulating and influence your life in subtle ways. You cannot meet them openly and directly, since you have condemned them to the dark.

Yet from the depths of that darkness, these repressed forces continue to shape your behaviour. They are dangerous, and keeping such forces bottled up inside is unhealthy.

They may suddenly break loose in a violent, uncontrollable outburst, a state akin to madness.

Paradoxically, society tolerates madness and fails to recognise meditation. Yet **it is through meditation that we become truly sane.**
36.commentary:
It is important now to release the tension and stress that have built up inside you.

Punch a pillow, jump into the air, go outside and run in the open, yell at the sky. Let loose in whatever way frees the energy inside you and allows it to flow again.

Do not wait for disaster to strike.

----------

37.name: Healing
37.main_text:
Your whole being is bound up with wounds you carry wherever you go. Nobody wishes to hurt or harm you. Everyone is far too busy tending to their own wounds.

Where would anyone find the energy to concern themselves with you? Yet sometimes you feel hurt because you are ready to be hurt. You stand like someone braced for a blow.

A person of the Tao cannot be hurt. Why? Simply because there is nothing left inside that can be struck. No inner wound remains to be reopened. Such a person is healthy, healed, whole.

The English word “whole” is beautiful. “Heal” and “holy” share its root. The person of the Tao is whole, healthy and holy.

Become aware of your wound. Instead of twisting the knife, help the wound close. It can heal only when you reach its roots.

The less you live in your head, the sooner the wound will heal. Without the mind's interference, there are no wounds. **Do not live in your head.**
37.commentary:
Old wounds buried deep inside you are coming to the surface, ready to heal. Under the healing influence of the King of Water, we no longer hide from ourselves or from others.

With such openness and acceptance, we can heal and help others find health and wholeness too.

----------

38.name: Receptivity
38.main_text:
Listening is one of the essential secrets of entering the temple of the divine. Listening is passive. It means forgetting yourself completely. That is true listening.

When you listen closely to someone, your “I” falls away. Unless you can step back from yourself, you cannot really listen. When you are too absorbed in yourself, you merely give the impression of listening.

You nod, you say “yes” or “no” here and there, yet the other person hardly matters to you. Someone who truly listens becomes a channel.

Passive and receptive like a womb, the listener becomes feminine. To reach this state, you must be feminine. You cannot reach God in the manner of an invader or a conqueror.

You will find God, or rather God will come to you, when your attitude is receptive and feminine.
38.commentary:
The Queen of Water ushers in a time without boundaries, a time of gratitude for everything life brings, free of expectations or demands.

Values such as duty, merit and reward lose their importance. Qualities like sensitivity, intuition and compassion begin to shine, sweeping away the obstacles that have kept us apart from one another and from the whole.

----------

39.name: Trust
39.main_text:
Do not waste your life seeking what will be taken away from you anyway.

Trust life. This is the only way to relinquish what you know and stop heeding your intellect. Out of trust, something immense will be born.

The life that until now seemed so ordinary will overflow with divine energy. When your heart is innocent and the walls around it fall, you come into contact with the infinite.

You can no longer be disappointed. Nothing remains that anyone could take away from you. What you can lose is hardly worth clinging to.

And can you really fear losing what cannot be lost? **It is impossible to lose your true inner treasure.**
39.commentary:
When you have the trust to take a quantum leap, preparations, plans and schedules become unnecessary.

There is no saying, “Right, I know exactly what I am going to do. I will pack my suitcase, buckle it up and take it along.” You simply leap. Just like that. Without a thought for what comes next.

All that matters is the leap itself, and the ecstasy of free fall.

----------

40.name: Understanding
40.main_text:
You are no longer a prisoner. You are outside the cage. You can spread your wings, and the whole sky is yours.

The sun, the moon and every star belong to you. You can disappear into the blue beyond...

Stop clinging to the bars of the cage. Come outside. The endless sky is waiting. Spread your wings and fly towards the sun like an eagle.

In your inner sky, in the universe of your consciousness, freedom is the highest good. Everything else comes second, even bliss and ecstasy.

There are countless flowers, but only in a climate of freedom do they bloom.
40.commentary:
It is natural to feel a little afraid at the first dawning of a new understanding, the realisation that the cage has always been open and the sky has long been waiting for us.

Yet do not let that fear take hold, or it will keep you from the great adventure before you.

Surrender to the gentleness and grace of this moment. Feel the flutter of wings inside you. **Take flight and be free.**

----------

41.name: Going With the Flow
41.main_text:
When I say, “Become water,” I mean become running water. Be like water in motion. Follow the current, keep moving, never grow stagnant.

The way of the Tao is fluid. Like water, it flows of its own accord. There is beauty in the course water takes. It always seeks the depths. It knows neither ambition nor the urge to come first.

Water follows its course, happy to be last. Remember the words of Jesus, “The last shall be first in the kingdom of heaven.” Without quite naming it, he describes the flowing way of the Tao.

You too can be last, setting ambition aside. If you are always trying to stand out by being the best, you are swimming against the current.

Water flows downhill. It descends to the source in the depths, seeking to be nobody at all. It makes no claim to being unique, exceptional or extraordinary. **It has no ego to maintain.**
41.commentary:
Drawing this card suggests that you are now able to let the current carry you, trusting life to take you in the direction it has in mind for you.

Give yourself over to that feeling of trust and ease. It will grow steadily within you. **Everything is unfolding just as it should.**

----------

42.name: Friendliness
42.main_text:
Meditate first. Once you are at peace, love will come naturally.

It will be just as beautiful, just as wonderful, to be alone as to be in the company of others. Everything is simple. You are free from dependence on others, and they are free from dependence on you.

You will live in an atmosphere of friendship and affection, where a genuine bond exists without attachment. You can form a relationship with someone without having to marry.

Marriages often rest on fear. Genuine relationships have their roots in love. They last as long as there is beauty and something to share.

When two paths diverge, the time has come to part. The lovers say goodbye in gratitude, each thanking the other for playing an important part in their life, for sharing so much joy and pleasure and so many beautiful moments.

When people have truly loved each other, they part without heartbreak or suffering.
42.commentary:
A new quality of friendship is entering your life and your relationships. You may notice that melodrama and romantic entanglements no longer hold much interest for you.

There is no loss in this passage. It is a new phase, the arrival of a higher quality of love, born of your own inner fullness.

Here comes **unconditional love, which expects nothing and asks for nothing.**

----------

43.name: Celebration
43.main_text:
Life is a moment to celebrate and savour. Make life a celebration, a joy, and you will enter the temple.

The temple has never been a place for spoilsports. Look at what exists around you.

Have you ever seen sadness in nature? A tree in a depression? A bird fretting? A neurotic wild animal? No, nature knows nothing of that state of sadness.

Human beings alone have lost their way, thinking themselves so wise and clever. Your intellect is your illness. Do not be too clever. Know when to stop, before you take things too far.

One measure of wisdom and one measure of foolishness make the recipe for the middle way to becoming a buddha.
43.commentary:
This card suggests you are growing more receptive to opportunities to celebrate life and are sharing that festive energy with those around you.

Why set a date to celebrate with your friends? Celebrate right now! Let your hair down, kick off your shoes and jump in the puddles. **The celebration is everywhere, at every moment!**

----------

44.name: Turning In
44.main_text:
Turning in has little to do with trying to turn something around or go somewhere. To look within is simply to notice how one unfulfilled desire after another carries you along, how you rush in every direction only to end up frustrated.

You realise then that every desire breeds suffering and never leads to inner fulfilment. You never arrive anywhere. Contentment stays beyond your reach.

Once this is clear, you will stop quite naturally and without any special effort. Trying hard to shed your attachments is itself a subtle attachment to detachment. You desire to be free of desire.

If you set out to “practise introspection”, once again you move away from the deeper truth. Every such attempt directs your gaze outwards, away from what is within.

You cannot “go” inside yourself. You are already there. There is no inward journey to make. The centre of awareness is no destination you can set out to reach. You are that centre.

How could you move towards it? When you stop moving, the tangled paths of thought fall away. When desire no longer clouds your mind, **you remain within yourself.** To look within is to observe your deepest, conscious nature, which is always present.

Turning your gaze inwards simply means that you have stopped turning it outwards.
44.commentary:
Learning to stand back from your own thoughts is one of the greatest blessings possible. This is what meditation means.

It takes neither a chanted mantra nor a repeated affirmation. Simply observe, as though your thoughts belonged to someone else.

You are ready now to step back and watch the scene without being caught up in it. Give yourself the simple freedom of looking within whenever you can.

The quality of your meditation is changing and **will deepen.**

----------

45.name: Clinging to the Past
45.main_text:
Your past, your present and your future exist in your mind, rather than in time.

What you no longer perceive is part of your past. What has yet to reach you lies in the future. What you are perceiving right now is called the present.

The past is what you no longer see before you. The future is what you see ahead of you. The present is what you see before you now, slipping away almost at once to become the past.

It is foolish to cling to the past. There is little point in regretting something that no longer exists. **What is gone is gone!**

Try to avoid clinging to the present moment too, for it is fleeting and will soon dissolve into the past. The future likewise holds only your desires and hopes. Loosen your grip on it. Tomorrow will turn into today, which in turn will belong to the past.

Everything becomes yesterday, becomes long ago. Everything slips away from you. Clinging brings only suffering and sorrow. Let things take their course.
45.commentary:
Trying to bring back the past keeps you stuck in old patterns you could have outgrown long ago, had you held the past a little less tightly.

Take a deep breath, set your box of memories down in front of you, tie it with a pretty ribbon if you like, and bid it a tender and final farewell.

----------

46.name: The Dream
46.main_text:
It has been said time and again throughout the centuries. The saints and sages of every age have proclaimed it. “We come into this world alone and we leave it alone.”

Becoming one with another person is an illusion. Our longing for intimacy has its roots in the pain we feel when we are alone. We try to forget our loneliness by forming relationships... That is why we rush into love affairs.

Try to look at this clearly. You think you fall in love with a particular person because they are beautiful, or for some similar reason. But that is hardly the real reason.

The truth is that you fall in love because you cannot bear to be alone. You fall in love to fill the emptiness within you, and so escape yourself.

Some people seek comfort elsewhere and fall in love with money. They become preoccupied with money, power and prestige, as politicians do. This too is a way of fleeing loneliness.

If you watch the people around you closely, and watch yourself as well, you will be surprised to find that all this activity comes down to a single cause, the fear of being alone. Every other explanation is a pretext.

The real reason is that **you cannot bear your own solitude.**
46.commentary:
True love grows as we mature and cultivate our own inner richness. Looking to another person to satisfy our desires only makes us dependent on them.

Then we will have so much love to give that we will draw lovers to us quite naturally.

----------

47.name: Projections
47.main_text:
At the cinema you watch the screen. You never turn around to look at the projector. Yet the screen holds only a play of light and shadow. The film itself is elsewhere.

The film is in the projector, and both are right behind you. You simply do not notice. Your intellect is like that projector. It is the starting point of your own private film.

Yet you keep looking outwards, and other people become your projection screen. When you love someone, that person seems incomparably beautiful. When you hate them, the very same person seems utterly hideous.

It never occurs to you that this person can be both beautiful and ugly, and that everything depends on how you look at them.

The only way to see reality is to try to perceive it directly, setting the mind aside. **The mind's interference only causes trouble**, since its chief occupation is to dream, interpret and distort.
47.commentary:
We all tend to project our own private films onto people and situations when we are unaware of our expectations, desires and opinions. We try to lay them at someone else's door instead of taking responsibility for them.

To break free of this game, all you need is to see it. Notice the game you are playing. When you catch yourself judging someone, ask yourself, “Could what I see in this person be something in me? Am I seeing clearly, or is my vision distorted by what I am unwilling to see in myself?”

----------

48.name: Letting Go
48.main_text:
Nothing in existence is superior or inferior. A blade of grass and the most majestic star are equal in worth...

Yet human beings keep wanting to rise above their surroundings. They feel they must dominate nature and so embark on an endless struggle. They want to outshine others and break records to prove they are someone special.

A human being is like a dewdrop on a lotus leaf, part of the infinite like a wave in the ocean. For such a person, “I” no longer means anything. **Innocence knows no ego.**
48.commentary:
This card tells us that a situation is coming to an end or is already over. It may be a job, a relationship, a home you loved, or something that helped define who you were.

It is time to let it go, however difficult that feels. Something greater is opening up for you, with unfamiliar dimensions to discover.

There is no retracing your steps now. Gravity is at work. Let this movement carry you. There is freedom in it.

----------

49.name: Laziness
49.main_text:
Laziness is a negative state. You have no energy. You feel heavy and sluggish, sleepy, half dead.

When you enter a state of non-action, on the other hand, your vitality is great and you are wide awake. This is a profoundly positive state. You glow and sparkle, brimming with vibrant energy.

You are fully alive and present, far from being half asleep. It is easy for the mind to set you a trap. It makes you believe that doing nothing is a state of laziness.

Then you say, “I have become a Zen master,” or, “I believe in the way of the Tao.” Take care. You are fooling yourself. Stay alert.
49.commentary:
The figure on this card seems quite convinced he has made it. He fails to notice the mirror on the right falling to pieces, a clear sign that the secure place he believes he occupies will soon collapse and disappear.

This card tells you that the place you occupy in life right now is no final destination. **The journey goes so much further. Kick off your slippers, put down your glass and set out now to explore the infinite worlds opening up to you!**

----------

50.name: Harmony
50.main_text:
Listen to your heart. Let it guide you, whatever the cost. Absolute simplicity is harmony between everything and nothing.

Being simple is difficult because you must give up all you have. To be simple, you must lose everything. To avoid losing anything, people prefer to be complicated, and so they forget how to be simple.

Only an innocent heart beats in time with the divine. A simple heart sings in deep harmony with God.

To reach that state, first you must find your own heart, beating to the rhythm that is yours, **the rhythm within you.**
50.commentary:
Try becoming gentler and more receptive. An inexpressible joy awaits you, very close at hand. No one can lead you to it, and when you find it you will be lost for words.

It is there in the depths of your heart, ripe and ready to be discovered.

----------

51.name: Control
51.main_text:
A person who represses their feelings is always tense. A current of nervous agitation persists deep inside.

When you stop controlling yourself, your life is alert and alive, like a flowing river. There is no room for nervousness. **What happens, happens.** You promise yourself nothing for the future and have nothing to prove. What is there to get worked up about?

To master that nervous mind, a repressed person must stay cold and unfeeling, blocking the flow of vital energy through their limbs and body. If they were to release that energy, everything they had repressed would rise to the surface.

This is why they have learned to remain indifferent, to avoid real contact with others, to look at people without truly seeing them. Their behaviour follows a script. “Hello! How are you?” Their words skim the surface. They have no intention of making genuine contact.

Such people never look into each other's eyes, hold hands or try to feel one another's energy. They allow no outpouring of feeling. Fear rules them so thoroughly that all they can do is **survive, cold and inert, in a straitjacket.**
51.commentary:
The King of Clouds advises us to breathe deeply, loosen our ties and relax.

Making mistakes is quite natural. Mistakes are even welcome, since **life offers so much more than being an expert in everything!**

----------

52.name: Morality
52.main_text:
As long as you live without awareness, your morality rings false and your culture is a thin veneer that crumbles at the lightest touch.

When morality springs from deep awareness rather than from a prescribed discipline, it is something else entirely. You meet situations with alertness and awareness, free from mechanical reactions.

Whatever you do will be right. Your inner light cannot give rise to evil. **Everything born of an aware heart is beautiful and right. It takes no effort and requires no practice.**
52.commentary:
The Queen of Clouds lives in the psyche of everyone taught to think in rigid categories of good and evil, sin and virtue, the acceptable and the unacceptable, moral and immoral ideas.

All these value judgements come from our conditioning. They keep us from discovering the beauty and divinity within. **Only by freeing ourselves from the prison of our conditioning do we find the truth of our own hearts.**

We begin to see life as it truly is.

----------

53.name: Fighting
53.main_text:
It was here a moment ago. Now it is gone. For a little while we inhabit the present moment. A moment later we leave it.

And in that brief interval, how much violence, emotion, fighting, conflict, anger and hatred! All for this one moment!

We are like people waiting for a train on the platform. Unable to sit still, we turn on one another, hurt one another, try to dominate and possess one another. **Politics in full fury.**

Then suddenly the train arrives and we disappear for good.
53.commentary:
A fighting temper or a simmering rage often conceals deep pain. We think that if we hurt others we will be spared hurt ourselves.

In fact, the opposite happens. A wound covered in armour cannot heal. And if we use it as a weapon against someone else, we shut out the love and nourishment we need in order to heal.

If you recognise yourself in this, it is time to lay down your arms. There is so much love to receive if you will allow it. **Begin by forgiving yourself. You are worth it.**

----------

54.name: Mind
54.main_text:
This is how I see your head. Steering wheels, pedals, all sorts of odds and ends you have picked up here and there and piled up any old way. **A proper junk heap.**

Your skull is crammed with things that crowd out your living space. They never stop rattling and creaking in your head. It keeps you occupied.

Take the time to look closely at your thoughts. One day, sit down quietly on your own. For half an hour, write down everything that comes into your mind. Then you will see what I mean.

You will be surprised at what goes on in your head. The chaos there is everywhere. It wraps you in a fog of thoughts through which you can neither see reality nor find spiritual clarity.

You need to let the mist clear. The simple resolve to do so is enough for it to lift of its own accord. **Remember, the fog is not clinging to you. You are the one who won't let it go!**
54.commentary:
The Page of Clouds tells you that somebody is thoroughly stuck in their head. Watch out, **it might be you!**

----------

55.name: Consciousness
55.main_text:
We come from the unknown and we return to it. We keep coming back. We have been here thousands of times and we will be here again.

You are an immortal being inhabiting a body. The body is a physical form, and it is fleeting. The things we live within, our home, our body, our intellect, all arise from matter. With time they wear out and die.

Yet your conscious intelligence, which the Buddha and Bodhidharma call no-mind, transcends matter and goes beyond body and mind. **It lies beyond the physical world.**

No-mind is eternal. It takes form and returns to the source of the unknown. This passage between the known and the unknown repeats itself over and over until our consciousness is enlightened.

A fully realised being is living their last incarnation. Once the flower has opened, it does not come back. Having found its deepest nature, it has nothing more to learn in the school of life.

Whoever understands that life is a schooling in the cycle of life and death is free of all the veils of illusion. **They will pass from the known into the unknowable, beyond even the unknown.**
55.commentary:
When this card appears in a reading, it means that a crystal clarity is now yours. You are experiencing a detachment rooted in the deepest silence at the heart of your being.

You no longer wish to grasp things with your intellect. Your understanding has become universal, in tune with the pulse of life.

Accept this wonderful gift and **share it with others.**

----------

56.name: Schizophrenia
56.main_text:
At this moment, you are not who you truly are. You have no existence of your own because you have no centre. You are like a crowd, a public square ringing with a multitude of different voices.

The instant you say “yes,” a “no” comes running. You cannot say “yes” with your whole heart. **This leaves no room for happiness.**

When you come apart inside, pain and suffering always follow.
56.commentary:
The figure on this card is a modern picture of Buridan's donkey, who died because he could not choose between a bucket of water and a bale of hay. That is exactly where we find ourselves when we are caught in indecision, with the mind pulling us two ways.

Should I go forward or back? This way or that? Say yes or say no? Whatever we eventually decide, in this frame of mind we will always think we might have chosen better.

The only way out of the dilemma is to choose neither and let go of both at once. Listing the pros and cons or thinking the problem to death will not give you an answer.

It is wiser to trust your heart and follow it. First, then, find your heart. If you can't, just jump. **Your heart will beat so fast you'll have no trouble finding it!**

----------

57.name: Ice-olation
57.main_text:
You can live within existence or make your ego your centre. You cannot do both at the same time.

When you focus your energy on your ego, you cut yourself off from existence. You live on an island hemmed in by boundaries you have drawn yourself. For you there is only “me” and “not me.”

That split is the ego, a state of isolation that hardens you. Your energy ceases to flow and gets stuck. People become like ice cubes, utterly without warmth. They have no love.

The warmth of love can melt them, and the boundaries disappear. In love, as in joy, there is no separation. **Neither love nor joy has any coldness in it.**
57.commentary:
The many-coloured tears of the figure on this card show the way out of “ice-olation.” Tears, and tears alone, can melt the ice that has formed inside us.

There is healing in crying, and nothing to be ashamed of. Crying helps us let go of our pain. We grow softer and gentler with ourselves, and **our tears help us heal.**

----------

58.name: Postponement
58.main_text:
It is foolish to put off a decision you could make today. Tomorrow you will still have to decide. So why not decide today?

Do you honestly think your mind will be clearer tomorrow? That you will be cleverer, younger and more vigorous than you are today? Tomorrow you will be older, less courageous, richer in experience but one step closer to death. You will tremble more and your fear will be greater.

Never put things off until tomorrow. There is no certainty that tomorrow will ever become today. **If you have a decision to make, make it now.**
58.commentary:
“Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today” is a saying few people take to heart. Yet when we put things off, they weigh on us.

Let go of your doubts and you will feel relieved. **You'll wonder why you waited so long.**

----------

59.name: Comparison
59.main_text:
Comparison keeps feelings of inferiority and superiority alive. When you stop comparing, those feelings fall away and you simply are.

It doesn't matter whether you are a scrubby bush or a towering tree. You are yourself. And existence wants you exactly as you are.

A blade of grass is as necessary as the greatest star. Without that blade of grass, something would be missing from the divine.

The cuckoo's call has the same worth as the Buddha's words. Without the cuckoo, the world would be poorer.

Look around you. Everything is needed, and everything has its place in existence. It forms a living whole in which nothing is higher and nothing lower. **No being is inferior or superior to another. Each is unique, beyond comparison.**
59.commentary:
Face the truth. There will always be someone more beautiful, more gifted, stronger, cleverer and happier than you.

There will also always be someone less fortunate. Comparing yourself with others will not tell you who you really are.

Look within yourself instead and see whether you are putting your own potential to use.

----------

60.name: The Burden
60.main_text:
Truth is nothing you have to attain. It is always here. Our work is simply to clear away the lies.

Every goal, every ideal, every ideology, religion and doctrine is deceptive by nature. Take care not to fall under their influence.

Recognise how readily the person you are today lends itself to falsehood. How easy it is for others to manipulate you and make you into whatever they want.

Looking for truth keeps you busy. You skirt what matters without ever touching it. This is how a lie stays hidden. Become aware of it and learn to tell falsehood from truth deep within yourself.

Once you acknowledge what is false in your personality, it disappears. When you stop seeking truth, you will no longer live a lie, because you will no longer need to. **When the lie goes, truth remains.**
60.commentary:
If life feels to you like one long struggle from birth to death, it is time to free your shoulders and carry on walking with nobody on your back.

Feel how light you are now. You have mountains of your own to climb. Dreams of your own to realise.

You need your energy to fulfil your wishes. You will always be short of it until you let go of the expectations you have taken on from others.

----------

61.name: Politics
61.main_text:
Anyone false and hypocritical is a potential political or religious leader. All it takes is a knack for deceiving people, a little cunning and a mask you can hide behind.

Politicians and priests lead a double life. They live behind a façade. The façade deceives. The truth is behind it.

A face whose expressions look innocent has in fact been carefully studied and rehearsed. If you want to know the truth, look at what that face conceals.

There you will see the politician, the priest, stripped bare. **These two kinds of cunning people have ruled humanity.**
61.commentary:
Do you recognise this man? Even the most innocent and sincere among us have a politician who has taken over the mind.

The mind acts like a politician hungry for power. It devises plans and tactics to manipulate situations and people for the sole purpose of getting what it wants.

Look closely at yourself. Have you played this shabby game too? What you learn about yourself may hurt, but it will hurt more to keep playing a game that does nobody any good, least of all you.

**Whatever you gain this way will slip like sand through your fingers.**

----------

62.name: Guilt
62.main_text:
Forget everything you know about sin and virtue. Both are foolish, and between them they have robbed humanity of the joy of living.

The sinner feels guilty, and guilt destroys their joy. How can you feel happy if you spend your time reproaching yourself and going to church to confess, always seeking forgiveness for what you have done, always trying to unburden your heart?

Under those conditions it is impossible to take delight in life. You feel heavy and weighed down. Remorse is like great stones crushing your chest, and with all that weight you cannot dance.

What place does remorse have in dancing, in music, in love, in life? Someone who feels guilty is not living. They are depressed. **They live as if they were dead, the light gone out of their heart.**
62.commentary:
You are fine just as you are. It is perfectly natural to make mistakes sometimes.

Learn from your mistakes, carry on your way and **take care not to fall into the same trap again.**

----------

63.name: Sorrow
63.main_text:
Pain is one way of becoming aware. It is only when the arrow pierces your heart and wounds you deeply that your awareness wakes up.

When life is easy, comfortable and pleasant, nothing troubles you. But when a friend dies, an opportunity opens up.

When the woman you love leaves you, your life seems to sink into darkness and you ache with loneliness. You loved her so much, and then one day it is all over and she goes.

The pain and the tears that follow are a blessed opportunity for you to become aware. The arrow hurts terribly, yet it also has its use.

**The nature of pain is to awaken your awareness, rather than to make you miserable.** When your innermost being wakes up, your suffering ceases.
63.commentary:
Great suffering has an enormous power to transform. For a change to take place, though, we have to go deep within ourselves, all the way down to the roots of our pain.

Surrender to the pain. Accept it as it is, without looking for someone to blame and without self-pity.

----------

64.name: Rebirth
64.main_text:
Zen says that you come from nowhere and go nowhere. You are simply here, in the present moment, neither leaving nor arriving anywhere.

Everything flows through you. Your deepest awareness lets the world outside pass through without identifying with it. It simply reflects what passes.

When a lion roars in front of a mirror, do you think the mirror roars back? When the lion leaves and a happy child stands before the mirror in its place, does the mirror start laughing with the child?

No, the mirror does nothing. It simply reflects what is. Your awareness is like that mirror. You neither come nor go. It is the events outside you that come and go.

You are born, you grow old and you die. **These are only reflections on the eternal lake of consciousness.**
64.commentary:
Whatever your state of awareness at the moment, whether you feel listless, depressed, angry or rebellious, know that you can grow and reach a new level of awareness if you are willing.

You are going through **a time of growth and change.**

----------

65.name: Abundance
65.main_text:
In the East, the body and matter have been condemned. Material things are called “illusory” (maya), things that seem to exist but have no real substance. Matter is said to be made of the same stuff as dreams.

The East, having denied the world, finds itself poor, sick and in misery. One half of humanity has embraced the inner world and rejected the outer. The other half has favoured the material world and ignored inner knowledge.

These two attitudes each fall short of a whole. **A person who is missing the other half of their being can never feel happy.**

We need to be whole, integrated, rich in the life of the body, in science, in meditation and in conscious intelligence. To my mind only a whole person is both healthy and holy.

I want Zorba and the Buddha to become one. By himself, Zorba is empty. His dance has no lasting meaning. It is the joy of a moment. Sooner or later he will tire of dancing.

To know fullness you must drink from the inexhaustible springs the cosmos offers you. To be whole, you must take root in existence itself.
65.commentary:
The King of Rainbows stands for a time of inner integration, of feminine and masculine energies, of earth and sky.

Say “yes.” Become whole, with all the colours of the rainbow shining through you. **You will see that existence supports you in all you do.**

----------

66.name: Flowering
66.main_text:
Zen urges you to live fully, totally, intensely. Christianity would have you turn the flame down low. Zen would have you live with all the energy overflowing in you.

Let your vitality spread and nourish others. Bliss, blessing and ecstasy need not stay locked inside you like a seed of possibility. Let that seed open like a flower and send its fragrance out to everyone around it, to strangers as well as friends.

This is true compassion, true love. **You share your inner light, your celebration of the unseen.**

The Queen of Rainbows is sensual, alive and brimming with possibility. She snaps her fingers to the melody of love. On her zodiac necklace, the sign of Venus rests over her heart.

Flowers rain down on her in harmony with her own flowering, and the waters of emotion swirl joyfully beneath the blossom that bears her.
66.commentary:
Perhaps you feel like a garden in bloom just now, receiving blessings from every direction.

Welcome the bees. Invite the birds to drink your nectar. **Let your joy radiate so that everyone can share it.**

----------

67.name: Slowing Down
67.main_text:
Meditation is a kind of medicine. Its use is temporary. Once you understand what it means simply to be in a meditative state, you will no longer need any particular method of meditation.

Meditation will be everywhere in your life. Walking is Zen. Sitting is Zen. How, then, will this find its own expression in you?

Your life is guided by alertness, conscious intelligence, unconditional joy and affection, with a clear channel through which energy flows.

Your walk will become a stroll. You will sit with love, alert and attentive, with no aim and no particular reason. Simply because it is lovely to sit doing nothing, to relax and rest!

In the same way, after a long walk you will sit down beneath a tree and enjoy the breeze as it cools you.

Each moment of life can be a chance to feel the purity within, without trying to improve, cultivate or practise anything.

Walking is Zen and sitting is Zen, speaking or keeping silent, moving or staying still. **The essence is at ease. The essence is at ease.** That is the key.

Do whatever you wish. Deep within, you remain serene, relaxed, calm and centred.
67.commentary:
There is nothing you need to do. Simply rest in your serenity.

Enjoy slowing down, enjoy the stillness, and **realise that you are already at home.**

----------

68.name: Adventure
68.main_text:
Truth, says Zen, has nothing to do with authority, tradition or the past. It is a radical, personal knowing, an individual experience. Each of us must discover it for ourselves.

There is security in the knowledge we start with. Searching for your own truth is a deeply uncertain undertaking. No one can guarantee you anything.

If you ask me for guarantees, I will tell you that only the dangers are certain. I can promise you that at any moment you may lose your way, and that your chances of reaching the goal are very small.

Yet one thing is sure. **The very act of searching for your own truth helps you grow.** I can promise you inner growth.

You will have to face dangers and make sacrifices, setting out each day into unknown, unpredictable country, without a map or a guide.

Yes, it will be hard going and you will often lose your way. But it is the only way to mature. We grow by passing through uncertainty.

Only someone who meets the challenge of the uncertain comes to know their inner truth.
68.commentary:
Whenever we approach something new and unknown with the trust of a child, innocent, open and vulnerable, **the smallest things in life can become the greatest adventures.**

----------

69.name: Maturity
69.main_text:
The difference between a seed and a flower in bloom is the same as the difference between the moment when you do not know you are a buddha and the moment you discover that you are.

In truth, you can be nothing other than a radiant inner light. **The buddha within is a being in full bloom, entirely open.** Every petal of its lotus has unfolded.
69.commentary:
The figure on this card can move in any direction, inward or outward, because his joy and maturity are independent of what happens around him.

He is centred in his heart, and he is expanding. The brilliant white light protects and guides him. All his experiences in life have brought him to this point of perfection.

This card is a reward for someone who has worked hard. The effort is now bearing fruit. You stand on firm ground, and success and fulfilment crown your work.

**This is the fruit of what you have already accomplished within yourself.**

----------

70.name: Moment to Moment
70.main_text:
The past is over and the future has yet to appear. Neither has any actual form. The past has lost its form, and the future has yet to acquire one.

To live in the space between them is to live from moment to moment, your arrow trained on the one moment that has real form, the present.

When awareness rests in the here and now, your whole being is absorbed in the reality of this moment. **This is the only path to the golden gate.**

The present is the golden gate. The here and now is the golden gate.
70.commentary:
This card invites us to bring our attention back from what is elsewhere and different, and give it to what is happening here and now.

Accept the way things unfold. Don't worry if you stumble. Pick yourself up, dust off your clothes and carry on your way.

----------

71.name: Guidance
71.main_text:
You look outside yourself for a guide because you have yet to recognise the guide within you.

Your task is to find that guide, that witness within, the Dharma, your inner buddha. When you awaken your own buddha, your life will be filled with grace and blessings.

For now, you cannot imagine the depth of goodness and divinity that awaits you. If your inner world is dark, find your way to the light within.
