One small candle is enough to light up the darkness. Once you find your inner light you will know the way out of the dark and into a higher awareness.

What follows is entirely natural. You do not stop to think or grope about or bump into walls, because you know instinctively where the way out is. **You know where to go, without hesitating or having to think it through.**
71.commentary:
Your inner light is trying to show you the way. Your inner guide speaks only in a whisper, and you aren't sure you have understood. That is why you hesitate.

Yet the message of this card is clear. Listen closely to the voice of your inner guide and it will lead you to your centre. You will act from there, whole and true to yourself, because your energy will no longer be directed outward.

**If you let it, the light will lead you exactly where you need to go.**

----------

72.name: The Miser
72.main_text:
In clinging to what you have, you deprive yourself of something fundamental to life, the chance to expand and to share.

The moment you cling to things, you lose your centre. Material possessions cannot bring you to your essential goal. The purpose of your life is you, your own being.

What matters is to have a beautiful soul. A beautiful house cannot give you that. In the same way, a fortune is no substitute for inner riches.

What counts, beyond everything you can accumulate, is **an open heart, aware and receptive to all that exists.**
72.commentary:
This card invites us to look at the things we are attached to. They have become so precious to us that we have built a fortress around them for protection.

It needn't be a handsome bank balance or a box full of jewels. It might be as simple as withholding time from a friend, or being afraid to tell someone you love them for fear of rejection.

If we block a spring, the water grows cloudy, stagnates and becomes undrinkable. If we lock up our riches and are unwilling to share them with others, they too lose their value and become useless.

Remember that material things may one day be taken from you. **Open your heart and enjoy the freedom that sharing brings.**

----------

73.name: The Outsider
73.main_text:
You feel left out. That's all right. You have just entered a time of transition. Take care now not to let pain and despair overwhelm you.

You think God has abandoned you and that nobody is left to comfort you. What you have yet to discover is that you need no comforting!

Humanity has come of age. Be a grown man or woman and stand on your own two feet. The only way to connect with existence is to look inside yourself.

The centre of your being has always been connected to life. At birth you were separated from your mother. That separation was necessary for you to become a person in your own right and live a life of your own.

But you were never cut off from the universe. An invisible tie connects you to it, a tie grounded in awareness.

To feel your connection with the universe, you must reach this level of awareness by looking deeply within, clear-eyed and attentive. Then you will find the path that connects you to your conscious heart.

**The buddha deep in your heart is the link.**
73.commentary:
When we are left out or turned away, it is the little child in us who feels abandoned and alone. That is hardly surprising, since the feeling has its roots in experiences from our earliest childhood.

You now have a chance to discover where that feeling began, to recognise the pain and to pass through it until you are free.

As things become clear within you, you will see that the gate is unlocked. **You can reach what you long for most.**

----------

74.name: Compromise
74.main_text:
Try to understand why you make compromises. Sooner or later you will see how little good this does you.

It is a way of avoiding a real decision or pushing down your confusion. Never push anything down. See your situation clearly.

If things are muddled, accept that. Know that you are confused. You will have taken your first step towards clarity. **Then the journey can begin.**
74.commentary:
The two figures on this card bring to mind the petty, dishonest situations we can get ourselves into when we compromise our own truth.

It is one thing to show understanding towards others, to accept a point of view that differs from our own and to try to bring opposing forces together. It is another to submit at the cost of betraying who we are.

When we look closely at our behaviour, we often find that we are trying to gain something, perhaps power or someone else's approval.

When that prospect tempts you, take care. **In the end, all that kind of compromise leaves you with is a bitter aftertaste.**

----------

75.name: Patience
75.main_text:
We have forgotten what patience is. Yet nothing is more precious than the ability to wait for the right moment.

All of existence knows how to be patient. A tree knows when to flower and when to let its leaves fall and stand bare under the sky. Even stripped of its leaves, the tree is beautiful.

It waits for spring with confidence. Knowing it will blossom again, it waits for the season of renewal without haste or impatience.

Human beings have lost that ability. We want everything to happen quickly. Our lack of patience is a loss for humanity.

When you wait in silence, something grows within you. **Your essential, authentic self unfolds.**
75.commentary:
The woman on this card is patient. Deep down she knows that all she can do is wait and let nature take its course.

She is neither drowsy nor indifferent. She knows the time has come to prepare for something wonderful. It is a lovely time, like the hour just before daybreak, when **waiting is exactly the right thing to do.**

----------

76.name: Ordinariness
76.main_text:
There are moments when you feel centred and whole. They are rare. You look out at the ocean in all its wild vastness and suddenly forget your divided self, the feeling of coming apart inside. You relax.

Or you are walking in the mountains and see pure snow, and for a second you feel as if you were in the Himalayas. A freshness of being comes over you. You feel quite simply yourself, with no need to put on an act. There is nobody there to play along.

You have come back inside yourself, back to your centre. It can happen when you listen to music, too. In such moments you feel a peace and happiness within, and a sense of grace and wholeness settles over you. You feel fulfilled, awake, complete.

There is no need to wait for these moments. They are there in everyday life. The philosophy of Zen is precisely to live the ordinary in an extraordinary way.

The most ordinary task, chopping wood or carrying water, can become an act of complete harmony. You can be happy cleaning the floor, cooking or doing the washing. It all depends on the spirit in which you do it.

**All it takes is to be fully present and bring joy to what you are doing.**
76.commentary:
Meet whatever situation arises with calm and simplicity, just as you are. You will do far better than if you try to be perfect, clever and extraordinary.

Let go of the need to come out on top or to keep impressing your friends with your exploits.

The best gift you can give right now is to **hold life lightly, go one step at a time and take it as it comes.**

----------

77.name: Ripeness
77.main_text:
Only when meditation has helped you find the light that shines through all your nights will you feel that death is a door opening onto the divine.

When light enfolds your heart, death becomes a passage into universal spirit, where you become one with the ocean of existence.

Until you have known this ocean, you will have lived in vain. The present is here and now, and the fruit is always ripe.

The present moment is always the right one. It is up to you to find the courage to enter your inner forest. **The ripe fruit waits only for you before it drops. The moment is always right, never too early and never too late.**
77.commentary:
This card tells you that you are ready to share your inner riches, the sap of your life. Simply relax wherever you are and accept what is.

Your creativity can find expression in many ways, in your work, in your relationships and in the things you do every day.

You have no preparations to make and no special effort is called for. **The time has simply come.**

----------

78.name: We Are the World
78.main_text:
When thousands upon thousands of people all around the earth celebrate their ecstasy, singing and dancing in their divine intoxication, collective suicide becomes absolutely impossible.

Can you imagine war arising in that atmosphere of celebration and joy, of natural, spontaneous vitality and health? No.

Life was given to you so that you could create, so that you could live in joy and happiness. When you weep, you are alone. When you celebrate, all existence joins in.

**Celebration alone opens us to the ultimate, to the eternal.** Only unconditional joy allows us to move beyond the cycle of death and life.
78.commentary:
When we discover the common source of our humanity, the place from which our dreams, our desires, our hopes and our fears all spring, we recognise that we are united in the great miracle of existence.

When we bring our immense inner riches together to make a circle of love and wisdom that is open to everyone, **we help draw the wondrous outline of an everlasting creation.**

----------
